gss_OID_desc_struct.doc: The structure for an OID descriptor that exchanges object identifiers with many GSS-API functions.

gss_OID_set_desc_struct.doc: The structure for an OID set descriptor that manages an array of OID descriptors.

gss_buffer_desc_struct.doc: The structure for a buffer descriptor that you use to exchange octet streams with many GSS-API functions.

gss_buffer_set_desc_struct.doc: The structure for a buffer set descriptor that you use to manage an array of buffer descriptors.

gss_channel_bindings_struct.doc: The structure defining a channel bindings descriptor that specifies the communications channel used to carry a context.

gss_iov_buffer_desc_struct.doc: The structure for a vectored I/O buffer and its defined type.
